human._note: Human baseline entry point. Play runs in viz (seed 42). Scores below are sample data until real human runs are collected.
human.controls: A/D walk, W jump, click a highlighted cell to mine, right-click to place, E cycles the block, F attacks; crafting in the bottom-right panel. Time only advances on a step.
concessions: Lockstep time: the world only advances when you act, so thinking is free (the same as for LLM agents).
Click to mine or place: cells in reach are highlighted; clicking one issues the matching primitive action.
Planned (site plan): pointing anywhere on screen highlights the furthest reachable cell in the direction of the mouse, so precise aiming is not part of the test.
